notes: model-rgb-256x256.png is R=(x), G=(y), B=(x+y)//2 per pixel (the same content as the WP1 probe's rgb_256x256); model-rgb-64x32.png is R=(x*255)//63, G=(y*255)//31, B=(x*3+y*5)%256 (the probe's rgb_64x32); geometry-max-4097x4097.png is R=(x*255)//4096, G=(y*255)//4096, B=(x+3y)%256 and exists only to exercise the smart_resize max-pixels branch (it is never exported losslessly). preprocessor_config.json is the byte copy of the pinned artifact's file of the same name; from_pretrained resolves the declared size (65536/16777216) from it for the fast processor.
